ORDERT.ORD_CODE = IPTEST.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT prod_code, MAX(WSTD_CODE) AS WSTD_CODE, MAX(WSTD_T32) AS WSTD_T32, MAX(WSTD_T33) AS WSTD_T33, MAX(WSTD_T41) AS WSTD_T41, MAX(WSTD_T42) AS WSTD_T42, MAX(WSTD_T87) AS WSTD_T87, MAX(WSTD_T43) AS WSTD_T43, MAX(WSTD_T44) AS WSTD_T44, MAX(WSTD_T51) AS WSTD_T51, MAX(WSTD_T52) AS SELECT A.jisi_lot, E.fac_name, C.ord_code, F.corp_name, D.prod_name, D.prod_no, D.prod_jai, D.PROD_PG + '' + D.PROD_PG1 + ' 이상' AS prod_cd, D.PROD_GD1 + ' ' + D.PROD_GD3 + ' '+ D.PROD_GD2 +'기준 '+ D.PROD_GD4 + '~' + D.PROD_GD5 AS prod_gd, '~' AS aaa, D.prod_e1, A.jisi_h_su, ROUND(A.jisi_h_jung,2) AS jisi_h_jung, A.jisi_h_pre_temp, A.jisi_h_chim_temp, A.jisi_h_diff_temp, A.jisi_h_gang_temp, A.jisi_h_pre_time, A.jisi_h_chim_time, A.jisi_h_diff_time, A.jisi_h_gang_time, A.jisi_h_chim_cp, A.jisi_h_diff_cp, A.jisi_h_gang_cp, A.jisi_h_cold_time, A.jisi_h_cold_temp, A.jisi_t_temp, A.jisi_t_time, A.jisi_h_regtime, G.TECH_TE, H.user_name, CASE WHEN jisi_lot IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('TK', LEFT(jisi_lot,6),'-',SUBSTRING(jisi_Lot,7,2), CASE WHEN RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) = '1' THEN 'A' WHEN RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) = '2' THEN 'B' ELSE RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) END ) END AS jisi_lot_view FROM tb_workheat A INNER JOIN ORDERT C ON A.jisi_ord_code = C.ord_code INNER JOIN PRODUCT D ON C.prod_code = D.prod_code INNER JOIN FACILITY E ON A.jisi_h_hogi = E.FAC_CODE INNER JOIN CORP F ON F.corp_code = D.corp_code INNER JOIN TECHIN G ON D.TECH_NO = G.TECH_NO INNER JOIN USERT H ON A.jisi_h_user_code = H.user_code WHERE 1=1 AND A.jisi_lot = #{jisi_lot}

SELECT A.jisi_h_code, A.jisi_h_su, ROUND(A.jisi_h_jung,3) AS jisi_h_jung, A.jisi_lot, B.ord_code, B.ord_name, ISNULL(B.ord_bigo,'') AS ord_bigo, B.ord_lot, B.ord_gyu, B.ord_su, B.ord_amnt, B.ord_mon, C.prod_no, C.prod_name, C.prod_gyu, C.prod_jai, C.prod_danj, C.prod_upjong, C.PROD_PG + ' ' + C.PROD_PG1 + '~' + C.PROD_PG2 AS prod_gd, -- 표면경도 C.PROD_GD1 + ' ' + C.PROD_GD3 + ' '+ C.PROD_GD2 +'기준 '+ workstd WHERE fac_code IN (1,2,3,4,18) ) G ON A.jisi_h_hogi = G.FAC_CODE AND C.prod_code = G.prod_code WHERE jisi_lot = #{jisi_lot}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),A.ord_input,23) AS ord_input, A.ord_code, D.corp_name, C.prod_name, C.prod_no, C.prod_code, A.ord_su, ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0) AS jisi_h_su, (A.ord_su - ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0)) AS jisi_diff_su, CASE WHEN wstd_t43 = '' THEN 0 ELSE REPLACE(wstd_t43,',','') END AS jisi_j_su, rnum FROM ordert A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ord_code, SUM(ilbo_su) AS jisi_h_su FROM workilbo WHERE ilbo_gubn = 'J' GROUP BY ord_code ) B ON A.ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON A.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON D.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY prod_code ORDER BY prod_code) AS rnum FROM workstd ) E ON C.PROD_CODE = E.PROD_CODE ) AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND ord_input >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND ord_input <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59') AND jisi_diff_su > 0 AND rnum = 1 ORDER BY ord_code

SELECT OCH_CODE, OCH_NO, CONVERT(char(10), ORD_DATE, 23) as ORD_DATE, CONVERT(char(10), OCH_DATE, 23) as OCH_DATE, OCH_SU, ROUND(OCH_AMNT,1) AS OCH_AMNT, OCH_NAME, OCH_BIGO, OCH_PRN, OCH_MON, OCH_LOT, ORDERT.ORD_CODE, PROD_GUBN, PROD_NAME, PROD_NO, PROD_JAI, PROD_GYU, PROD_DANW, OCH_DANG, PROD_DANJ, CORP_NAME, TECH_TE, OCH_MA, CORP_GYUL2 FROM OCHULGO INNER JOIN ORDERT ON ORDERT.ORD_CODE = OCHULGO.ORD_CODE INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = ORDERT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON CORP.CORP_CODE = PRODUCT.CORP_CODE INNER JOIN TECHIN ON TECHIN.TECH_NO = PRODUCT.TECH_NO WHERE 1=1 AND OCH_DATE BETWEEN CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59') AND OCH_CODE != 0
AND prod_gubn = #{prod_gubn}

SELECT (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(ILBO_SU) FROM WORKILBO WHERE ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE and ILBO_GUBN='A') AS ILBO_SU, (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(ILBO_JUNG) FROM WORKILBO WHERE ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE and ILBO_GUBN='A') AS ILBO_JUNG, ORDERT.ORD_CODE, CONVERT(char(10), ORD_DATE, 23) as ORD_DATE, ORD_SU, ROUND(ORD_AMNT,2) as ORD_AMNT, ORD_NAME, ORD_BIGO, ORD_LOT, PROD_GUBN, PROD_NAME, PROD_NO, PROD_JAI, PROD_GYU, ORD_DANW, ORD_DANG, ORD_DANJ,TECH_TE, CORP_NAME,CORP_GYUL2, ORD_SU - ISNULL(OCH_SU_SUM,0) AS jaego_su, ORD_SU - ISNULL(OCH_SU_SUM,0) AS och_su, ROUND(ORD_AMNT - (ISNULL(OCH_AMNT_SUM,0)),2) AS jaego_amnt, ROUND(ORD_AMNT - (ISNULL(OCH_AMNT_SUM,0)),2) AS och_amnt, CASE WHEN ORD_DANW = 'KG' THEN ORD_DANG * ( ORD_AMNT - ISNULL(OCH_AMNT_SUM,0) ) ELSE ORD_DANG * ( ORD_SU - ISNULL(OCH_SU_SUM,0)) END as och_mon FROM ORDERT -- 여기서 부터 WHERE 종료 부분까지는 공통 INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = ORDERT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON CORP.CORP_CODE = PRODUCT.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(ORD_CODE) AS ORD_CODE, COUNT (ORD_CODE) AS COUNT, SUM(OCH_SU) AS OCH_SU_SUM, SUM(OCH_AMNT) AS OCH_AMNT_SUM FROM OCHULGO GROUP BY ORD_CODE ) OCHULGO_SUM ON OCHULGO_SUM.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE WHERE 0 < ORD_SU - ISNULL(OCH_SU_SUM,0) AND ORDERT.ORD_DATE between #{sdate} + ' 00:00' and #{edate} + ' 23:59'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OCHULGO (OCH_CODE ,ORD_CODE ,OCH_DATE ,OCH_AMNT ,OCH_DANW ,OCH_LOT ,OCH_DANG ,OCH_MON ,OCH_BIGO ,OCH_PRN ,OCH_SU ,OCH_MA ,OCH_CHK ,OCH_CHKD ,TEND_CODE ,OCH_GUBN ,ILBO_CODE ,ILBO_NO ,OCH_TOTALSU ,OCH_NAME) VALUES ((SELECT ISNULL(MAX(OCH_CODE), 0)+1 AS och_code FROM OCHULGO) ,#{ord_code} --ORD_CODE, numeric(18,0) ,#{och_date} --OCH_DATE, datetime ,#{och_amnt} --OCH_AMNT, float ,#{ord_danw} --OCH_DANW, nvarchar(5) ,#{ord_lot} --OCH_LOT, nvarchar(30) ,#{ord_dang} --OCH_DANG, float ,#{och_mon} --OCH_MON, float ,#{och_bigo} --OCH_BIGO, nvarchar(500) ,0 --OCH_PRN, char(1) ,#{och_su} --OCH_SU, float ,#{och_ma} --OCH_MA, nvarchar(10) ,0 --OCH_CHK, nvarchar(1) ,'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' --OCH_CHKD, datetime ,#{tend_code} --TEND_CODE, numeric(18,0) ,0 --OCH_GUBN, char(1) ,0 --ILBO_CODE, numeric(18,0) ,0 --ILBO_NO, numeric(18,0) ,'' --OCH_TOTALSU, float ,#{och_name} --입고담당자 )
